· MACD histogram trajectory (4.0231 → 4.8257) — Continuous improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $294.31) — Trading near the mid-band, with band width expanding to 23.26%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($300.50) — Support based on pivot and 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($363.18) — Below 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low) — Confirming recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Considering entry for buy due to RSI settling in neutral and MACD improvement.
